makkah.name: Jabal al-Noor & Ghar Hira
makkah.desc: The Mountain of Light where Prophet Muhammad ﷺ received the first divine revelations of the Holy Quran through Angel Jibreel (AS).

makkah.name: Jabal Thawr
makkah.desc: The cave where Prophet Muhammad ﷺ and Hazrat Abu Bakr Siddique (RA) stayed during the historic Hijrah to Madina.

makkah.name: Maidan-e-Arafat & Jabal-ar-Rahmah
makkah.desc: The Mount of Mercy where the Prophet delivered his Farewell Sermon (Khutbat-ul-Wada).

makkah.name: Mina & Muzdalifah
makkah.desc: The tent city of Mina and the open plain of Muzdalifah central to Hajj rites.

makkah.name: Jannat al-Mu'alla
makkah.desc: The historic cemetery of Makkah where Mother of Believers Hazrat Khadijah (RA) is resting.

makkah.name: Masjid Jin & Masjid Shajarah
makkah.desc: Historical mosques in Makkah marking significant miraculous events in early Islamic history.

madina.name: Masjid Quba
madina.desc: The very first mosque built in Islamic history. Offering two rakats prayer here carries reward equal to an Umrah.

madina.name: Masjid al-Qiblatain
madina.desc: The Mosque of Two Qiblas where the direction of prayer was divinely changed from Jerusalem to the Holy Kaaba.

madina.name: Mount Uhud & Shuhada Uhud
madina.desc: Site of the historic Battle of Uhud and resting place of Sayyid ash-Shuhada Hazrat Hamza (RA) and 70 Sahaba.

madina.name: Jannat al-Baqi
madina.desc: The sacred graveyard adjacent to Masjid an-Nabawi where over 10,000 Sahaba and Ahle Bait rest.

madina.name: Sab'ah Masajid (Masjid Al-Fath / Battle of Trench)
madina.desc: Site of the Battle of Khandaq (Trench) featuring historical companion mosques.

madina.name: Bir Ali (Dhul Hulayfah Miqat)
madina.desc: The official Miqat point for pilgrims traveling from Madina to Makkah to assume Ihram.
